Maps runtime transaction errors to transaction result metric indexes.

# Purpose
This header file defines [`fd_bank_err_from_runtime_err`](<#fd_bank_err_from_runtime_err>), a small inline mapping function that converts runtime transaction error codes into the matching transaction result metric index values. It includes the log, runtime error, and metrics enum headers so it can translate known `FD_RUNTIME_*` error values into `FD_METRICS_ENUM_TRANSACTION_RESULT_*` values. Several runtime errors are grouped into the `default` path, where `FD_LOG_ERR` reports an unknown error code and the function then returns `0`. The file acts as a translation layer between runtime error handling and metrics reporting in the bank code.
